name: 1-boardwalk.jpg
label: Boardwalk at dusk
description: On foot on the beachfront road at dusk: the hero Brisa GT parked beside Marlow, the boardwalk Ferris wheel and the neon strip behind, palms and beach umbrellas along the sand.

name: 2-play.jpg
label: The Strip, behind the wheel
description: Behind the wheel of the Brisa GT on Neon Avenue at dusk: palm-lined sidewalks, the PAWN shop and the diner awning, traffic and lit windows down the strip.

name: 3-chase.jpg
label: Three stars, night pursuit
description: A three-star night pursuit on the Strip: three wanted stars lit, cruisers and the air unit on dispatch, a marked cruiser boxing the Brisa GT in on the right.

name: 4-docks.jpg
label: The cargo port
description: The container port in the afternoon: Marlow on the quay, a gantry crane straddling the stacked containers behind, the port yard under a pale sky.
